# GNU coreutils compatibility — `org.ono.compat.coreutils`

Version `0.1.0`; process.exec executables: `stat`, `df`. Everything below is the pack's contract; an invocation not listed under an adapter runs raw, and the limits state what the adapted form does not carry.

## stat — `org.ono.compat.coreutils.stat`

Files as `ono.file/1` records, from `stat --printf` with NUL-terminated records.

| | |
|---|---|
| executable | `stat` |
| versions | `>=8.0` |
| tier | B — stable machine-readable format |
| schema | `ono.file/1` |
| decoder | `lines` |
| demand | structured, interactive |
| fallback | raw |
| fixtures | `coreutils/stat` |

### Supported invocations

| invocation | runs as | flags allowed | flags required |
|---|---|---|---|
| `stat [-L\|--dereference] <path …>` | `stat --printf=%s\t%F\t%a\t%U\t%G\t%Y\t%X\t%W\t%i\t%d\t%n\0` | `-L`, `--dereference` | — |

### Fields

| field | from |
|---|---|
| `accessed` | `accessed`, unit Seconds |
| `created` | `created`, unit Seconds |
| `device` | `device` |
| `group` | `group` |
| `inode` | `inode` |
| `kind` | `kind` |
| `mode` | `mode` |
| `modified` | `modified`, unit Seconds |
| `name` | `path` |
| `owner` | `owner` |
| `path` | `path` |
| `size` | `size`, unit Bytes |

### Limits

- `-f/--file-system`, `-c/--format`, `--printf` and `-t/--terse` change what a row is and run raw.
- `target` is not reported: `stat`'s `%N` quotes the link target in a locale-dependent way; `find -printf %l` answers it.
- A `kind` stat spells differently from the eight it knows is a schema violation, never `other`.

## df — `org.ono.compat.coreutils.df`

Filesystems as `ono.filesystem/1` records, from `df --output` in bytes.

| | |
|---|---|
| executable | `df` |
| versions | `>=8.21` |
| tier | B — stable machine-readable format |
| schema | `ono.filesystem/1` |
| decoder | `lines` |
| demand | structured, interactive |
| fallback | raw |
| fixtures | `coreutils/df` |

### Supported invocations

| invocation | runs as | flags allowed | flags required |
|---|---|---|---|
| `df [-a\|--all] [-l\|--local] [-t\|--type <fs>] [-x\|--exclude-type <fs>] [path …]` | `df --block-size=1 --output=source,fstype,size,used,avail,target` | `-a`, `--all`, `-l`, `--local`, `--sync`, `--no-sync`, `-t <value>`, `--type <value>`, `-x <value>`, `--exclude-type <value>` | — |

### Fields

| field | from |
|---|---|
| `available` | `available`, unit Bytes |
| `size` | `size`, unit Bytes |
| `source` | `source` |
| `target` | `target` |
| `type` | `type` |
| `used` | `used`, unit Bytes |

### Limits

- `-h`, `-H`, `-k`, `-B`, `-i`, `--output` and `-P` change the columns or the units and run raw; the adapter always asks for bytes.
- `uuid`, `label`, `read_only` and `device` are not reported: `get filesystem` answers them.
